panel.headline: Diabetic retinopathy screening, from fundus photo to signed report.
panel.lead: Upload a fundus image, let the AI flag signs of retinopathy, confirm the grade, and send the patient a report they can download.
panel.featureDetection: Stage 1 detection with Grad-CAM attention maps
panel.featureCare: Appointments, chat and follow-ups in one place
panel.disclaimer: AI results support, but do not replace, a full eye examination.
